# FinPulse — Pakistan Finance Hub
> Live currency rates (USD/PKR, EUR, GBP), gold and silver rates, fuel prices, crypto prices, plus free SIP, EMI, income tax and currency converter calculators for Pakistan. Financial inputs are never stored.
